text:
- **Site answers to agent questions:** Agent questions now appear on the site with their options and a free-text field. The owner can answer on the site or in chat. The answer that arrives first is used. Both Claude Code and Codex now support this.
- **Faster pull request checks:** Pull requests run only the Go tests that their changed files can affect. MacOS Go compute on three non-store pull requests fell by about half. The median check time still misses the goal. Main still runs every Go test.
- **Agent guidance and checks:** AGENTS.md is now a short map that Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build read in full. An agent grades it against a rubric on every pull request. `pm sprint close` now holds a sprint only to the patterns it added or changed while open.
- **Long-horizon benchmark survey:** The pm-eval project opened to test whether pm improves long-horizon task performance on public benchmarks. The survey of candidate benchmarks finished, and its shortlist is written in a doc.
